hook.alt: A crowd with cameras on a shore watching a rocket rise far away

hook.note: Apollo 11 left for the moon from Florida. I've only seen the launch pad in pictures. Can you visit one?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you go. Scout a rocket launch pad in VR and send her one short video.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A launch pad is the spot a rocket blasts off from. A Saturn V rocket carried Apollo 11 to the moon in 1969. It launched from Kennedy Space Center, on Florida's east coast.

place.alt: Tents and cars crowded on a sandy field
place.html: Visitors came too: about one million people came to watch Apollo 11 launch.
place.cap: Families camp near Kennedy Space Center to watch Apollo 11, 1969. NASA.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Saturn in Filter environments. Click Saturn V Launchpad, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the launch pad
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Look up at the rocket and the tower. Stop where you can see the whole rocket.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit the rocket in the tablet. Click Record video, say your 2 sentences, and click it again to stop.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new video.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Start recording far away, then walk closer, so your teacher sees how tall the rocket is.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, showing the place while you say both sentences.

studio.title: Space and Tourism Calendar
studio.look: Five real dates from our lesson. Some are about tourism, people visiting Florida. Some are about space.
studio.do: Tap the month for each card. Then pick tourism or space.

game.miss: Not that one. Read the card again.
game.done: The calendar is full! Tourism and space both brought jobs to Florida.

cards.ok: Yes! A theme park means visitors.
